free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the patient presents with a high PSA of 9.1 ng/mL and a rising velocity of 1.48 ng/mL/yr, coupled with a PI-RADS 4 lesion identified on MRI. Although the prior biopsy was positive, the current clinical picture of rising PSA and a high-risk lesion warrants further investigation to determine if the disease has progressed or if the prior finding requires re-staging. The evidence strongly supports sampling to clarify the current status.
